context: Dashboard & Enterprise Operations for Hotel and FnB Inventory
theme: Light mode primary with dark mode support, hospitality executive aesthetic, sharp edges with subtle 8px border radius, high density data presentation with clean typography
archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY / LUXURY HOSPITALITY (Warm sand, obsidian, emerald accents, professional executive slate)

typography.headings: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif

roles.permissions: Full access to all multi-outlet inventories, user management, HPP formulas, financial reports, system configuration
Create & manage Purchase Orders (PO), supplier database, price comparison, receiving validation
Manage stock in/out, goods receiving (GRN), transfers between outlets (Kitchen, Bar, Housekeeping), Stock Opname count
HPP calculation, Flash Cost tracking, cost variance reports, invoice matching, financial analytics in Rupiah (IDR)

key_modules.name: Master Barang & Kategori
features: Item database with flexible units (kg, liter, pcs, carton)

key_modules.name: Flash Cost Daily
features: Daily food & beverage cost percentage tracking vs revenue

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully interactive, production-grade React application in /app/frontend/src with Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Shadcn UI components. Ensure all modules (Dashboard, Master Barang, Purchase Order, Penerimaan Barang, Barang Keluar, Stock Opname, Perhitungan HPP, Flash Cost, and Role Switcher) are fully functional with realistic mock data in Rupiah (IDR), complete state management, filtering, search, modal forms for creating/editing, export/print simulation, and data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='po-submit-btn')
Never use pure black #000000 or grey without tint. Use slate/zinc color scales.
Use 2-3x comfortable spacing. Generous padding in cards (p-6 or p-8).
Ensure all buttons have hover states and explicit text colors.
Do not use forbidden fonts (Inter for headings, space grotesk) or forbidden colors (#1B93A4, #7351B7).
